title: Patient Management
description: Patient Management documentation for System Admin.
overview: This guide covers patient management workflows for System Admin.

subtasks.title: Look Up Patient (general search)
subtasks.purpose: Locate a patient across every practice using demographic and organisational filters.

steps.title: Open Lookup Patient
steps.description: Click Patient Mgmt in the sidebar, then choose Lookup Patient from the fly-out menu.

steps.title: Enter Search Criteria
steps.description: Enter any combination of Last Name, First Name, and pick Practice, Provider, Caregiver and Status from the dropdowns.

steps.title: Run or Reset Search
steps.description: Click Query to run the search, or Reset to clear the filters.

steps.title: Review Vitals Chips
steps.description: Review results in the table — Vitals chips show which measurement types (BP, BG, WT) are being monitored.

steps.title: Filter Search Results
steps.description: Use the Search box (top-right) for further in-table filtering. Notes Leaving all filters blank returns an empty grid; at least one filter must be supplied before Query runs. This screen shows the latest vital readings — for date-scoped billing views use 6.6.2 (RPM) or 6.6.3 (CCM).

subtasks.title: Look Up Patient (By RPM Date)
subtasks.purpose: Report RPM service activity for a practice over a chosen date range, including CPT eligibility.

steps.title: Open RPM Lookup
steps.description: Click Patient Mgmt in the sidebar, then choose Lookup Patient (by RPM date).

steps.title: Select a Practice
steps.description: Select a Practice from the dropdown.

steps.title: Pick RPM Date Range
steps.description: Pick an RPM Service Date Range (from ~ to).

steps.title: Load or Reset Results
steps.description: Click Query to load results, or Reset to clear.

steps.title: Sort RPM Results
steps.description: Sort by RPM Start Date or any other column via the column header.

steps.title: Print the Report
steps.description: Click Print to send the report to the printer.

steps.title: Export the Report
steps.description: Click Export to download in CSV / Excel format.

steps.title: Email the Report
steps.description: Click Email to send the report to a recipient. Notes Measurement Days counts unique calendar days with at least one qualifying vital upload — this drives CPT code eligibility (99453 / 99454 / 99457 / 99458). Modal # and Serial # show the device model and serial actively assigned during the reporting window.

subtasks.title: Look Up Patient (By CCM Date)
subtasks.purpose: Report CCM service activity for a practice over a chosen date range with billing status.

steps.title: Open CCM Lookup
steps.description: Click Patient Mgmt in the sidebar, then choose Lookup Patient (by CCM date).

steps.title: Select a Practice
steps.description: Select a Practice from the dropdown.

steps.title: Pick CCM Date Range
steps.description: Pick a CCM Service Date Range (from ~ to).

steps.title: Load or Reset Results
steps.description: Click Query to load results, or Reset to clear.

steps.title: Sort CCM Results
steps.description: Sort by Enrollment Date or any other column.

steps.title: Distribute the Report
steps.description: Click Print, Export or Email to distribute the report. Notes Billing = Pending means the patient qualifies but has not been billed for the current cycle; Locked means the billing has already been finalised. Chronic Conditions lists the ICD diagnoses that qualify the patient for CCM (e.g. Alzheimer’s Disease / Dementia, Arthritis). Task 6.7 — Care Management
